headline: Rate hikes lift earnings, FFO despite lower occupancy
summary_short: Q2 2026 diluted EPS was $0.50 (+19.1% y/y, -10.7% q/q) as revenue grew 5.6% y/y to $397.8M; FFO per share rose to $0.77 from $0.69 y/y, while Core Portfolio occupancy slipped to 93.8% from 94.3%.
summary_long: Revenue grew 5.6% y/y to $397.8M as MH base rents rose 5.8% and Core Annual RV/marina rents rose 5.4%, while Core occupancy slipped to 93.8% from 94.3% on new expansion sites. Net income rose 19.2% y/y to $99.5M, helped by a $7.1M insurance recovery for hurricane-related capex reimbursement. FFO per share rose to $0.77 from $0.69 y/y; Normalized FFO per share, which excludes that recovery, rose a smaller 7.7% to $0.74. Operating expenses grew a slower 2.9%. ELS consolidated the remaining RVC joint-venture interests for $4.4M. No new guidance was issued. Total assets rose to $5.80B; the credit line had $372.4M of capacity left.
